newsitem.title: LATVIA: DAUGAVPILS YR PROFIT APPROVED AT 615,000 LATS.
newsitem.headline: DAUGAVPILS YR PROFIT APPROVED AT 615,000 LATS.

text.p: Shareholders of Daugavpils Chain on Friday approved all the resolutions put to them by the board, including a planned 615,000 lats net profit, a Daugavpils shareholder told Reuters.
The planned 1997 profit compares with a 1996 profit of 1.65 million lats.
Shareholders also approved putting all of last year's profit into long-term investments and that no dividends would be paid, the shareholder also said.
The shareholder meeting backed all the points on the agenda, he added.
The planned turnover for 1997 is around 8 million lats compared with a 1996 figure of 8.39 million lats, the shareholder added.
A meeting will be held in two weeks time to approve a planned bonus issue of 84 shares for every 100 shares held.
